name: Lumi's Huiskamer
prompt_dna: Lumi's cosy living room inside the hollow of an old tree (the tree-house den from the Dreamnest valley): round organic wooden walls with visible wood grain, a low round ceiling, everything soft and hand-made.

layers.background: a big round window with soft rain drops sliding down the glass, outside a deep blue night with a smiling round full moon called Momo, distant glowing bell flowers and wisteria
layers.middle: a small round stone fireplace with a gently crackling warm fire, a wooden rocking chair with a knitted blanket, a little round table with a steaming teapot, a round wall clock shaped like a sleeping cat
layers.foreground: thick hand-knitted round rugs in lilac and cream, soft cushions, a small star-shaped night light glowing warm yellow

lights: moonlight through the window (cool soft blue rim light)
ambient_motion: rain drops slide down the window
steam curls up from the teapot
cat clock pendulum swings very slowly
dust motes float in the firelight
sounds: a quiet ticking clock (optional, very soft)
notes: Set-plaat v1 gekozen door Milan op 13-11-2026.
